schema_note: Blocks validate against nlp_reports app/models; parameter_type, document_type, QualityAttribute criticality fields, StudyDesign and DesignSpace are local extensions (see schema_extensions_used).
schema_extensions_used: RevisionEntry / GroundTruthAnnex.supersedes (new) — the revision layer, anchored on the rendered revision-history rows
out_of_schema_notes: The transfer plan spans the whole train. Entities are the two sites, the Step 3-10 process steps (each anchored on its rows of the process train, characterization scope and chronology tables), the eleven drug substance quality attributes, every parameter of the train with the set-point, NOR and class in force at Version 2.0 (PTP-001 carries the class of each step report and does not re-derive it), every method validation of the procedures table, the development train and the commercial equipment train, the control strategy elements and the modular viral clearance claims. ProcessParameter.PAR carries the characterized range, as everywhere in the corpus; the plan claims no proven acceptable range and draws no design space, so it has neither record.

QualityAttribute.acceptance_criteria are the drug substance criteria of the attribute table; tool2_severity is left empty because PTP-001 does not state it. associated_steps and the step_has_quality_attribute assertions follow the principal role of each step in the process train table, plus the prose that states where aggregate forms at low pH; they are not the 'set_by' column of the CQA register, which PTP-001 does not print. QualityAttribute.analytical_method is the method the plan pairs with the attribute (for aggregate, AMV-3221, the SEC record transferred).

acceptance_criteria is empty. PTP-001 sets no step criterion (an ExplicitNonClaim), prints no criteria-change table and no table of intermediate acceptance criteria; it refers to PCMP-001 Version 2.0 §7.3 and states only their number. The drug substance criteria are attribute_has_acceptance_criterion assertions on the attribute rows.

The plan has no designed experiment of its own and lists no study, only the number of studies and the execution window of each step (statements on the chronology rows). The one study it names, S-BRX-SDM, the first characterization study, is a StudyDesign without design fields.

The seven transfer gaps keep the gap ids of the Version 1.0 annex; each is anchored on its row of the gap table and on the sentences of the gap analysis that say how it is closed or managed. Every gap is 'open': the plan closes none, and it says that the gaps on harvest and UF/DF and on viral clearance are managed, not closed. transfer_has_gap assertions have the subject transfer:amab_ds.

Each ModularContribution is one claimed step of a cumulative viral clearance requirement, anchored on the sentence that states the claims of that virus and on the attribute row that carries the requirement. ControlStrategyElement records are the three layers of the control strategy, the contents of the master batch record, the clearance route for residual DNA and the batch-record control of the viral clearance load conditions.

The rows of the six pipe tables (package, process train, site equivalency, characterization scope, gaps, deliverables) are rebuilt by re-running the chunk that prints each, with every cross-reference written as the rendered document numbers it. Each changed set-point and NOR is a statement anchored on its footnote of the parameter table and on its row.

AnalyticalMethod records: every method validation of the procedures table, each anchored on its row there, the nine methods to be transferred also on their row of the methods table, and the methods the prose discusses on its sentences. The qualified performance of each transferred method is a statement on its row. AMV-3011 (SEC for size variants) and the two infectivity titre assays are not transferred (ExplicitNonClaim records); nrCE-SDS (AMV-3020) is transferred with no row in the record of qualified method performance. The concept of a method carries the title of its validation as canonical name.

The approval table, the abbreviations and the procedure rows of the procedures table that the prose does not discuss are not represented. No rhetorical_spans (a plan has no spans file). weak_claims is empty, and the plan carries no registered discrepancy.
